author: jsign
content:
The PR of this thread is https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3248 (EIP-7688) happening in `execution-specs`.
This means that the way `hash_tree_root` works in SSZ changed. This was a change included in `glamsterdam-devnet-7`. (So a while ago already).

Changing `execution-specs` to EIP-7688 means the CL has to calculate the same hash_tree_root to check public inputs.

author: jsign
content: This convo about CL lagging behind at least in these kind of changes, adds friction in how zkboost would work. Since the CL would be calculating the old hash_tree_root style, and the execution_specs is using the decided new hash_tree_root style (progressive containers)

author: jsign
content:
So I see three options:
1. Update CL to at least `glamsterdam-devnet-7` which is the natural  thing
2. Make zkboost do some gymnastics on how public input is checked reg using newer hash_tree_root style different from how CL does it
3. Skip the public input check until eventually CL is properly rebased
